## vpick-video-creator 1.0.2 Changelog

- Added a new "Security & Data Handling" section to the documentation.
- Clarified authentication: all access is via MCP link with embedded token; no extra API keys needed.
- Explained data flow, storage, and billing (charges go to VPick credits; prompts/media are routed through VPick and sent to third-party providers).
- Emphasized no local credentials or environment variables are required.
- Updated prerequisite steps to reflect the streamlined security and connection process.
